trigger: Ambient: Ruth teaching kids in the convention hall corner.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: In a corner, twenty kids on yoga mats. An old woman with a whiteboard: 'TODAY: FRACTIONS (FOOD).'

nodes.speaker: amb_ruth
nodes.text: If your family has three cans and four people, how much does each person get? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A kid: 'Three-fourths of a can.' Another: 'Zero, my uncle eats it.' Ruth writes both down.

nodes.speaker: amb_ruth
nodes.text: Thirty-eight years of second grade. Never had a class this good at fractions. Isn't that awful?
